headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 22, 2026**
article:
The Minnesota Twins suffered a 5-2 loss to the Cleveland Guardians, with Ryan Jeffers leading the Twins' offense with a home run and an RBI. The Los Angeles Dodgers secured a narrow 2-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Max Muncy hitting a home run and driving in two runs. The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Toronto Blue Jays, winning 12-2 behind Nick Fortes' three hits, one home run, and four RBIs.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, affecting their teams' lineups and rotations. J.T. Ginn, a right-hander for the Athletics, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right middle finger blister. The move is retroactive to July 18, 2026. Other players on the injured list include Stephen Kolek (Kansas City Royals), Bobby Witt Jr. (Kansas City Royals), Drey Jameson (Arizona Diamondbacks), Jack Flaherty (Detroit Tigers), Jose Corniell (Texas Rangers), Will Smith (Los Angeles Dodgers), and Joshua Kuroda-Grauer (Athletics).

Several trades and roster moves have taken place, affecting teams' pitching staffs and lineups. The Houston Astros acquired right-handed pitcher Max Martin from the Kansas City Royals in a trade. The Los Angeles Dodgers acquired Seth Halvorsen from the Colorado Rockies in exchange for Nick Frasso and Landyn Vidourek. The Athletics traded Aaron Civale to the Chicago Cubs for Aiden Moffett, while the Kansas City Royals traded Rudy Martin Jr. to the Baltimore Orioles for cash.

top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers secured a narrow win over the Philadelphia Phillies, with a final score of 2-1. Max Muncy led the Dodgers' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rays Cruise Past Blue Jays 12-2**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Toronto Blue Jays, securing a 12-2 victory. Nick Fortes led the offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Padres Take Down Braves 8-3**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres secured an 8-3 victory over the Atlanta Braves, with Manny Machado leading the charge at the plate. Machado hit two home runs and drove in two runs in the game.

top_news.title: **Athletics RHP J.T. Ginn Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Athletics right-hander J.T. Ginn has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right middle finger blister. The move is retroactive to July 18, 2026.

top_news.title: **Astros Acquire RHP Max Martin in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, acquiring right-handed pitcher Max Martin in a trade. Martin joins the Astros after being dealt from the Kansas City Royals.
